gloss: to dress (fish); to handle skillfully; to sell off

definitions.gloss: to dress (fish or game); to fillet; to butcher
definitions.explanation: To cut up a fish, chicken, or other animal into edible parts — removing scales, bones, or organs. A standard kitchen / fishmonger skill.

definitions.gloss: to handle skillfully; to manage; to deal with
definitions.explanation: To deal smoothly with a large number of things — work, customers, tasks, traffic — without getting overwhelmed. Implies competence and speed.

notes:
Transitive godan verb. Both senses share the core idea of 'cutting through and handling efficiently'. Note that ⟦{裁|さば}く→裁く：02112_sabaku⟧ (judge a case) and ⟦{砂漠|さばく}→砂漠：09508_sabaku⟧ (desert) are unrelated homophones.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捌|さば}く: to dress / fillet a fish
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捌|さば}く: to power through work
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捌|さば}く: to sell off inventory
- ⟦{交通|こうつう}→交通：01584_koutsuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{捌|さば}く: (police, etc.) to manage traffic flow

ASPECT (ている):
{捌|さば}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ often describes someone in the middle of efficiently handling work or customers, emphasizing the continuous, smooth flow of activity.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to process; to handle — more formal/neutral; lacks the 'skillful flow' nuance of {捌|さば}く
- ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deal with — used for responding to situations / requests, more passive feel
